1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __selected from the group consisting of ablation, resection, biopsy, drug delivery, and neuromodulation__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from the group consisting of an ablation electrode, a resection tool, a biopsy needle, and a neuromodulation lead__.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device remains in contact with the tissue layers throughout the procedure__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __and maintaining radial expansion of the device throughout the medical procedure__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by maintaining the radial expansion during introduction of the medical element__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __selected from the group consisting of ablation, resection, biopsy, drug delivery, and neuromodulation__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from the group consisting of an ablation electrode, a resection tool, a biopsy needle, and a neuromodulation lead__.

9. (Original) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining radial expansion of the device throughout the medical procedure__.

11. (Original) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue.

12. (Original) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.

13. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __selected from the group consisting of ablation, resection, biopsy, drug delivery, and neuromodulation__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from the group consisting of an ablation electrode, a resection tool, a biopsy needle, and a neuromodulation lead__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining radial expansion of the device throughout the medical procedure__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
